hints.title: Common Divisor Partition Constraint
hints.text: The deck can be partitioned into equal groups of size X if all card count values share a common divisor of at least two.

hints.title: Frequency Extraction
hints.text: Count occurrences of every distinct card number in the deck.

hints.title: Greatest Common Divisor Reduction
hints.text: Compute the greatest common divisor across all counts. If the running divisor is at least two, return true, otherwise false.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List
from collections import Counter
import math
from functools import reduce

class Solution:
    def hasGroupsSizeX(self, deck: List[int]) -> bool:
        counts = Counter(deck).values()
        return reduce(math.gcd, counts) >= 2
```

variables: N: number of cards in deck
complexity.notes: Counting frequencies and computing greatest common divisor across counts.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing every possible group size from 2 to N with trial divisions is redundant.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Frequency count storage scales with distinct cards.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use greatest common divisor across all frequency counts.
